debit.sms: SMS 'HOT' to 9230192301 from the registered mobile: 'HOT' hot-lists all cards attached to that mobile no.; 'HOT' + last 4 digits hot-lists the specific card; 'HOT'<14 digit account no.> hot-lists all cards linked to that account.
debit.notes: Hotlisting is available 24x7 - the bank's own wording is 'at any point of time'. The toll-free appears as '1800 8910' site-wide (site header and hotlist instructions) while the FAQ spells the Customer Service Hotline as 1800-103-0123; a 24x7 multilingual assistance toll-free, 1800-26-78729, also appears on the debit-card page. App path: hotlist through the UCO M-Banking Plus app; the UCO Secure app can additionally disable a card's ATM/POS/e-commerce services. WhatsApp channel 8334001234 also hotlists debit cards. Netbanking: log in at ebanking.uco.bank.in, where 'Debit Card Hotlisting' and 'Enable/Disable ADC Channel' are listed retail services. Lost/stolen cards can also be reported by email to uco.custcare@ucobank.co.in. No overseas helpline is published on the official pages verified; the 1930 national helpline is not mentioned on them.

credit.notes: UCO Bank publishes SBI Cards' 'Policy for the issuance and conduct of credit cards' on its website and routes credit-card servicing through SBI Card's dedicated 24x7 call centre: 1860 500 1290, 1860 180 1290 or 39 02 02 02 (prefix local STD code); 1800 180 1290 is toll-free. Executives answer 8 AM - 8 PM Monday to Saturday, with lines open 24x7 for emergency and premium services. Requests can also be emailed to customercare@sbicard.com or sent via www.sbicard.com/email and the SBI Card mobile app. No UCO-side SMS keyword, netbanking block path or overseas number is published for credit cards.

upi.notes: App freeze path: UCO mBanking Plus (Android store link above; the same app 'also provides the UCO Secure facility') — post-login feature table lists the 'UCO Digi Safe' group containing 'Block/ Unblock UPI' alongside 'UPI Limit Management', 'ADC Block/ Block all Digital Transactions' and 'Account Debit Freeze'. The digital-products FAQ answers 'What if someone linked my account through UPI?' with: 'Call customer care (1800 8910) for blocking of ADC channel. or Contact branch for account freeze. Use UCO secure and disable UPI.' The standalone UCO Secure app 'Instantly block/un-block Bank's digital products including Debit Card, m-banking, BHIM UCO UPI, UCOPAY +(e-wallet), e-banking' and these services 'can be blocked / unblocked at one Go' (its own page publishes download links only as shorteners/image: bit.ly/UCOSecI, w.m2y.co/uco/s/, /documents/d/guest/android-ios). The FAQ warns card hotlisting does not stop UPI: 'Once UPI PIN is set blocking of ATM doesn't block UPI... So blocking of UPI is necessary.' UPI disputes/queries: 'Toll Free Customer Care: 1800 103 0123, Department: 033-44559084/9459'. Netbanking publishes no UPI-named manage path (retail e-banking list has only '8.10 Enable/Disable ADC Channel'). No UPI SMS keyword is published; *99# appears on the FAQ only as NPCI's transaction product, not a block channel. iOS is published only via the bank's shorteners (bit.ly/UCOmBankingIOS for mBanking Plus) with no direct App Store URL, so no iosApp URL is recorded.
